hints.title: Boundary Interior Balance
hints.text: A subarray is stable if the sum of its first and last elements equals the sum of its interior elements.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Rearrangement
hints.text: Rewrite nums[i] + nums[j] = P[j] - P[i+1] into single-index terms: nums[i] + P[i+1] = P[j] - nums[j].

hints.title: Sliding Index Hash Map
hints.text: Store past left side keys in a frequency map and match with incoming right side keys.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def countStableSubarrays(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        P = [0] * (n + 1)
        for idx in range(n):
            P[idx + 1] = P[idx] + nums[idx]
            
        count = 0
        left_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for j in range(2, n):
            i = j - 2
            left_key = nums[i] + P[i + 1]
            left_counts[left_key] += 1
            right_key = P[j] - nums[j]
            count += left_counts[right_key]
        return count
```

complexity.notes: Linear time with sliding frequency map of decoupled prefix terms.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic testing of all subarrays times out for large N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for prefix arrays and key frequency table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Algebraically isolate terms to enable single pass frequency matching.
